The failing test `testInfiniteLoop` is calling the `printHelp` method of `HelpFormatter` class with a width set to 20. The current bug report describes that when there is not enough space to display a word on a single line, `HelpFormatter` goes into an infinite loop until the JVM crashes with an OutOfMemoryError.

Looking at the implementation of the `printHelp` method in the `HelpFormatter` class, we can see that it calls another overloaded `printHelp` method with a default width value:

```java
332 :     public void printHelp(String cmdLineSyntax, Options options)
333 :     {
334 :         printHelp(defaultWidth, cmdLineSyntax, null, options, null, false);
335 :     }
```

The issue likely arises from the default width value being too small to fit the long description provided in the test case. This causes the `HelpFormatter` to go into an infinite loop trying to fit the text within the width limit, eventually leading to a crash.

To fix this issue, the default width value should be set to a larger value to accommodate long descriptions without causing an infinite loop.

Next, I will suggest the method that needs to be fixed.
